lane: single co-training/disagreement lane: magnetic tilt-depth proxy in View A; strictly surface DVA2/HVA and radiometrics in View B; bounded A-only disagreement boost
ranked_hypotheses: H97-A: magnetic tilt-depth A-only disagreement with H84 surface-only anisotropy B (selected primary; no experiment at preregistration)
H97-B: gravity upward continuation / second vertical derivative with strict surface B (deferred)
H97-C: Werner magnetic contact depth-and-dip continuity with strict surface B (deferred)
H97-D: H96 cover/strain/seismic A-only disagreement grafted onto H84 strict surface B (deferred)

new_features: tilt_depth_proxy_m: half nearest-contour distance sum for +45/-45 degree TDR levels, times 100 m, capped at 5000 m
view_A.formula: TDR=atan2(band9, abs(band3)+0.01*median(abs(band3)[eligible])); pos45=eligible & (theta>=pi/4); neg45=eligible & (theta<=-pi/4); depth_proxy=min(0.5*(EDT(~pos45)+EDT(~neg45))*100,5000), set to 0 outside eligible & |theta|<=pi/4

view_B.channel_features: H84 DVA2/HVA/COH channels for bands 12 det_elev and 19 det_elev_slope only
view_B.prohibited_channels: No gravity/depth/geophysical H84 channels in View B

historical_control.name: h84_B_DVA2
historical_control.note: H84 B_DVA2 is a mixed-view-by-content comparator (its DVA2 channel bank includes bands 13/15/18); H97's trained A/B views are strictly disjoint. Refit this control on the H97 mask and report drift; do not present the historic value as an organizer score.

mask.mismatch_action: STOP before supervised fit; no cross-mask comparator

pseudo_label_policy.training_exchange: conditional on clean canary, measured independence below 0.60, and View-A sufficiency thresholds
pseudo_label_policy.reason: No exchange if any gate fails; prior N-1 refutes plain exchange on two instruments and H91/H96 document repeated View-A sufficiency failures. If permitted, use shared whole_pseudo_segments with registered 50x50 blocks, 5-pixel minimum, 2000-pixel cap, visible-catalogue exclusion, and the 80-pixel holdout buffer; hidden-region labels never enter selection or training.

candidate_formula: score = 0.80*rB + 0.20*((rA-0.95)/0.05) if rA>=0.95 and 0.35<=rB<=0.65; otherwise 0.80*rB. rA/rB are percentile ranks over each fold's allowed region, not labels.

holdout.bootstrap: paired physical-block percentile; 1000 draws; block_side=200; seed=61052
holdout.promotion_bar: refit H84 B_DVA2 on the exact H97 mask; candidate paired 95% CI lower bound must exceed zero versus that same-run control and pooled candidate DTI must exceed 0.19282907051926573; no slot selection is made

lane_gate.full_registry: evidence/ctd5_prior_inventory.json plus submission/, docs/downloads/, data/scored/, data/reference/
lane_gate.dot_stop: any single prior with >70% of emitted dots within 3 pixels

leakage_canary_features: every cached feature used by H97 plus both tilt-depth features and all H84 channels used in either strict View B or incumbent control; direction-insensitive single-feature AUC on the held-out fold region
provenance: inputs integrity-pinned to registry/data_manifest.json; not organizer-authenticated. USGS GeoDAWN external layers were restored from the owner mirror and SHA-verified, not freshly fetched from USGS.
